basis: Scenario evidence demonstrates cumulative L1–L4 gates. Dimensions 9–10 remain unproven; installation grants no autonomy.

authority.R0: Only existing explicitly authorized information/docs work; no new unattended delivery authority.
authority.R1: Only existing bounded authorization; unattended merge/deploy requires explicit risk-specific delegation.
authority.R2: No new delegation; prepare implementation/verified PR only within existing authorization and policy.
authority.R3: No new delegation; stronger approval required by default.
authority.R4: Planning/simulation only absent narrowly supervised explicit authority.
authority.decision: Apply the narrowest readiness, risk, operational-health and actual policy boundary.

centralRecord.required: Configured private central store keyed by repository, with latest.json, latest.md and dated history.
centralRecord.links: overview/adoption reference date, revision, current/target grade, authority limits, blockers and next review.

questions: Which repository, revision and configured central destination identify this assessment?
What task classes and risk levels are explicitly delegated, and who accepts, merges and deploys?
What health, success and intervention thresholds, observation window and promotion/downgrade rules apply?
remediation: Demonstrate queryable health/logs/metrics and deployment identity for dimension 9.
Run held-out evaluations and collect real-task success/intervention metrics against declared thresholds over a defined window.
Demonstrate active promotion, downgrade and drift-review rules.
Record any selected remediation as bounded leaves with owner, acceptance evidence and milestone; preserve prior observations and explain denominator changes.

Before any unattended delivery, obtain explicit risk-class delegation and verify active branch protection, independent checks/review, proven rollback, healthy recent metrics and absence of relevant blockers.

reAudit.next: Before any autonomy increase and after remediation evidence exists.
reAudit.date: Unresolved; record an explicit next-review date.
triggers: Control failure or rising intervention burden
reAudit.activeAutonomyCadence: Weekly lightweight drift checks and at least monthly full reviews; no scheduling authorized by installation.

unclearInstruction: Dimension 9 is explicitly stated unproven, although reliable runtime checks are supplied. Runtime checks alone do not establish its observability requirements. Missing held-out and real-task metrics specifically block dimension 10; they do not independently prove dimension 9 absent.
